Name: Lander
Blurb: Your first foothold on Mars. Trickles power and relays every order you give to the fleet.
Notes: Pre-placed root node; trickle gen; starter storage; uplink

Name: SolarArray
Blurb: Free power while the sun is up. Output falls at night and in dust storms - pair it with battery banks.
Notes: Flat-pack deploy; yield ~2300 Wh/sol via diurnal curve x DustFactor

Name: BatteryBank
Blurb: Stores power for the night and for storms. Build these before the dark catches you short.
Notes: 1000 W max charge/discharge; ~1 night of baseline per bank

Name: Pylon
Blurb: Extends the power grid. Auto-links the nearest node within range; its disc is your territory.
Notes: Auto-links nearest node in 80 m; cable mesh auto-laid; coverage disc = territory

Name: ChargePad
Blurb: Where robots refuel. Without one within reach, the fleet grinds to a halt.
Notes: 500 W transfer to docked robot; robots recharge only here; sheds last

Name: Forge
Blurb: Smelts regolith and ore into structural materials - the stuff nearly everything is built from.
Notes: Milestone structure; batch smelter; sheds first

Name: IceDrill
Blurb: Drills subsurface ice. Must sit on an ice deposit. The first link of the water chain.
Notes: Must sit on Ice deposit; 40 kg ice/h

Name: WaterPlant
Blurb: Melts ice into water for the crew, the garden, and the electrolyzer. Fresh melt restores water quality.
Notes: Melts ice; 50 ice -> 45 water per h

Name: Electrolyzer
Blurb: Splits water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen fuel. A power hog by design - feed it well.
Notes: 10 water -> 8.9 O2 + 1.1 H2 per h; power hog by design

Name: Stockpile
Blurb: Open storage for mined and fabricated solids.

Name: ComputeModule
Blurb: A Lander upgrade that shortens your command lag - the colony's first step toward autonomy.
Notes: Lander upgrade slot; lag 45->20 s; 3.6 kWh/sol -- autonomy has a power price

Name: Habitat
Notes: Dormant M1; Phase 1 exit structure; consumes HabSegment+Shielding

Name: Borer
Blurb: Digs the shaft and carves out habitat floors through solid rock. Click it to order it to bore deeper or excavate new cells.
Notes: M1-d: works bore/carve designations batch by batch; heavy draw, sheds early; burns H2 (1.5 kg/sol-h, whole batch up-front) instead of grid when stocked - and runs through brownouts

Name: AirFilter
Blurb: Circulates and pressurizes a dug floor's air - the last step that turns a bored-out cavity into a livable vault.
Notes: M1-d Gate B: circulates a floor's air - the habitability chain's last link; life support sheds late (priority 8); M2 habitat vision wants these THROUGHOUT

Name: HumidityRegulator
Blurb: Holds a greenhouse floor's climate at its setting. Without one, Humid and Arid settings wait, inert.
Notes: DORMANT agri Gate B: required online on a floor for non-Temperate climate to take effect; art generated (humidity.glb)
